create_openai_conversational_task: create an OpenAIConversationalTask instance for conversational inference with OpenAI API
prepare_openai_api_key: prepare and validate an OpenAI API key, rejecting None and Hugging Face hf_ prefixed keys
prepare_openai_mapping_info: prepare an InferenceProviderMapping for a given OpenAI model ID like gpt-4o or o1
test_openai_conversational_task: test the OpenAIConversationalTask class initialization with provider and base_url
review_openai_provider: review the OpenAIConversationalTask class and its API key and mapping validation methods
